description: "Merak ve yaratıcı tasarımla hareket eden iki kişilik bir görev. Uzay araştırmaları kavramlarını herkes için daha erişilebilir ve ilgi çekici hale getirmek adına teknik araştırmayı güçlü bir hikaye anlatımı ve görsel tasarımla birleştiriyoruz. 48 saat içinde sınırları zorlamaya ve sıra dışı bir şey inşa etmeye hazırız!"
summary: Abandoned, But Not Forgotten is an interactive 3D scrollytelling web museum and planetary atlas that gives a voice to seven iconic NASA spacecraft left behind on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space—combining real launch telemetry, official 3D NASA models, and NSSDCA-verified archives for students.
details:
Over 187 tons of human-made hardware rest silently on the Moon, alongside robotic pioneers across Mars. Once their signals stop, students often view them as abandoned scrap, while authentic mission data remains fragmented across separate technical catalogs.

Built by Team The BlackBirds (combining software engineering with high-school storytelling), "Abandoned, But Not Forgotten" unites these archives into a zero-install, bilingual (EN/TR) web experience:

• 60 FPS Scroll-Driven Launch: Scrolling ignites the real OSIRIS-REx Atlas V 411 rocket (NASA SVS #12716) synced with live altitude, velocity, and thrust telemetry.

• 360° Official 3D NASA Inventory: Interactive <model-viewer> inspection and hardware hotspots for Apollo 11 LM Eagle, Lunar Roving Vehicle (Apollo 15/16/17), Viking 1, Opportunity, InSight, Ingenuity, and Voyager 1.

• NSSDCA-Verified Cards & Audio Logs: Every spacecraft features verified UTC/local dates, lifespan comparisons, direct NSSDCA links, and Web Speech API voice narration.

• Interactive Modules: InSight 2018 vs. 2022 dust-accumulation selfie slider, Voyager 1 Golden Record audio & Pale Blue Dot gallery, a Leaflet.js Moon/Mars Trek coordinate map, and a Space Heritage Quiz.
